revision_reason: Unify an early soft sunset cover with the duohertz high-contrast frequency-print system while retaining the amber relay motif
cover_prompt: Edit Image 1 into a new square cover-art candidate for duohertz track Amberwave Relay. Preserve its distinctive concept: a warm amber sun pulse travels as one continuous waveform through staggered tall glass-panel frames, like a signal being handed across the scene. Transform the soft purple 3D sunset and realistic horizon into a bold original editorial comic-print collage for an all-ages electronic rhythm game. Image 2 is only a reference for duohertz's near-black ink and warm-ivory print texture, large silhouette, halftone restraint, and accent color discipline; DO NOT copy its two circular frequency rings or radial composition. Make a large flat amber-yellow sun disc on the left, two or three offset angular near-black and ivory relay frames across the center, and a single crisp electric-cyan waveform crossing them to the right. Add sparse coral beat markers and angled paper shadows. High contrast, energetic, legible at 100px; reserve the lower 20 percent dark for a separate local title overlay. No sky, mountains, ocean, glass realism, tiny music notes, text, letters, logos, characters, or copied game art. Square 1:1.
og_prompt: Create a wide horizontal 1.9:1 social-sharing card for duohertz track Amberwave Relay from the supplied NEW square cover. Preserve its original high-contrast editorial comic-print style, large amber-yellow sun disc, staggered angular ivory relay frames, and one crisp electric-cyan waveform passing through them. Recompose the sun, frames, and wave mostly in the RIGHT two-thirds; leave the LEFT third calm near-black ink with generous negative space. Add exactly two lines of clear typography in that left third: 'duohertz' all lowercase in electric cyan, smaller; 'Amberwave Relay' in warm ivory, larger. Spell exactly d-u-o-h-e-r-t-z and A-m-b-e-r-w-a-v-e space R-e-l-a-y. No other letters, words, icons, logos, watermarks, sky, ocean, mountains, photorealistic glass or copied game imagery. The graphic motif must unmistakably match the supplied cover and remain legible at a small share-card size.
cover_svg: Local SVG brand/title overlay around cover-art.png; bitmap source has no text

previous_art_provenance.cover_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original square cover-art illustration for Glass Horizon, an all-ages Synthwave song in the duohertz electronic rhythm game. A broad soft apricot horizon glow seen through layered translucent indigo glass panels, a single clean cyan waveform crossing the horizon, small friendly musical light particles, lavender and pale gold accents. Distinct from two interlocking circular rings on the First Frequency cover. Contemporary editorial album art, warm and optimistic, richly detailed but readable at thumbnail size. No text, letters, logo, characters, cars, weapons, red neon city, flashing stripes or copied game art.
